FILE - In this photo provided by the North Korean government, its leader Kim Jong Un, center, and his daughter, reportedly named Kim Ju Ae, visit a military training base in North Korea, Thursday, March 19, 2026. Independent journalists were not given access to cover the event depicted in this image distributed by the North Korean government. The content of this image is as provided and cannot be independently verified.
 
 
 朝鮮通信社/KCNA via KNS via AP

paragraphs.zh:
资料图——这张由朝鲜政府提供的照片显示，2026年3月19日（星期四），朝鲜领导人金正恩（居中）与其女儿（据称名为金主爱）视察朝鲜一处军事训练基地。独立记者未获准采访报道这张由朝鲜政府发布的照片所描绘的活动。图片内容系原样提供，无法独立核实。



朝鲜中央通讯社/KCNA via KNS via AP



隐藏图注

paragraphs.en: SEOUL, South Korea — Until she fled North Korea three years ago, Kim Yumi felt deeply frustrated whenever state TV showed leader Kim Jong Un with his young daughter. The message, she felt, was clear and worrying: North Korea was laying the groundwork for an eventual hereditary transfer of power, this time to Kim's daughter.
paragraphs.zh: 韩国首尔——三年前逃离朝鲜之前，金由美（Kim Yumi）每当国家电视台播放领导人金正恩与幼女一同出现的画面，都感到深深沮丧。她觉得，传递出的信息明确而令人担忧：朝鲜正在为最终实现权力世袭交接铺路，而这一次的接班人是金正恩的女儿。

paragraphs.en: Publicly questioning the Kim dynasty's hold on power would mean severe persecution. Already angered by draconian pandemic regulations that ruined her family's fishing business, she defected to South Korea by boat with her family.
paragraphs.zh: 公开质疑金氏王朝对权力的掌控，意味着遭受严厉迫害。本就因严苛的疫情管控措施毁掉家族渔业生意而愤怒的她，与家人乘船逃往韩国。

paragraphs.en: "My husband and I didn't want our children to live under a fourth-generation dictatorship. As parents, we thought the best thing we could do for our children was to give them freedom," said Kim Yumi, 32, who now lives in Seoul.
paragraphs.zh: “我和丈夫不想让我们的孩子生活在第四代独裁统治之下。作为父母，我们认为能为孩子做的最好的事，就是给他们自由。”现年32岁、目前居住在首尔的金由美说。

paragraphs.en: North Korea allows no dissent and harshly punishes attempts to flee the country. Established in 1948, the nation is nominally a socialist republic, but in reality it is an authoritarian dynasty, with three generations of the Kim family ruling in succession. There was no known public resistance during its previous two successions — from state founder Kim Il Sung to his son Kim Jong Il in 1994 and then from Kim Jong Il to his son Kim Jong Un in 2011.
paragraphs.zh: 朝鲜不允许任何异见，并对试图逃离国家的人施以严厉惩罚。该国成立于1948年，名义上是社会主义共和国，实质上是威权王朝，金家三代相继执政。此前两次权力交接——1994年国家缔造者金日成传位其子金正日，以及2011年金正日传位其子金正恩——均未出现已知的公开抵抗。

paragraphs.en: The question of who will become North Korea's next leader is crucial because that person will face a huge challenge — governing an impoverished, nuclear-armed nation whose 26 million people have little political freedom and live under strict state surveillance while being cut off from much of the outside world.
paragraphs.zh: 谁将成为朝鲜下一任领导人这一问题至关重要，因为此人将面临巨大挑战——治理一个贫穷的拥核国家，其2600万民众几乎没有政治自由，生活在严格的国家监控之下，并与外部世界的大部分隔绝。

paragraphs.en: To gauge North Koreans' private views, The Associated Press spoke with nearly a dozen defectors who still have contacts in North Korea or witnessed the country's previous power successions, as well as several experts.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解朝鲜民众的私下看法，美联社采访了近十名脱北者，他们仍与朝鲜境内保持联系，或目睹了该国此前的权力交接，此外还采访了数位专家。

paragraphs.en: Since late 2022, she has made dozens of public appearances, all of them with her father at big events like weapons tests and military parades. State media has called her Kim's "most beloved" and "respected" child. Her status has been emphasized by images showing an elderly general kneeling before her and her standing in front of her father.
paragraphs.zh: 自2022年底以来，她已公开露面数十次，全部是与父亲一同出席武器试验和阅兵等重大活动。官方媒体称她是金正恩“最心爱”和“最受尊敬”的孩子。有画面显示一位年迈的将军在她面前下跪，而她站在父亲身前，这进一步凸显了她的地位。

paragraphs.en: South Korea's spy agency says she is Kim's likely heir. Eight of the 11 defectors interviewed by the AP shared that view; the others disagreed, citing the North's deeply patriarchal culture.
paragraphs.zh: 韩国情报机构称，她很可能是金正恩的接班人。美联社采访的11名脱北者中有8人持相同看法；其他人则不同意，理由是朝鲜有着根深蒂固的父权文化。

paragraphs.en: "During her visits to missile launch sites and factories, the way senior North Korean officials treat Kim Ju Ae involves protocols reserved for a successor, not the ones simply for a daughter of Kim Jong Un," said Tae Yongho, a former minister at North Korea's Embassy in London who defected to South Korea in 2016. "They are repeating the same protocol and treatment they provided for Kim Jong Un," when he accompanied his father as his heir.
paragraphs.zh: “在她视察导弹发射场和工厂期间，朝鲜高级官员对待金主爱的方式，采用的是为接班人保留的礼遇，而非仅仅作为金正恩女儿应有的礼遇。”2016年叛逃至韩国的朝鲜驻伦敦大使馆前公使太永浩（Tae Yongho）说，“他们正在重复当年为金正恩提供的同样礼遇和待遇”，那时金正恩作为接班人陪同父亲出行。
